overview: An Amazon-style e-commerce product catalog with a complete search and filter system. Features real-time search suggestions in the navigation bar, a dedicated search results page with advanced sidebar filters, and category browsing pages — all with shareable URL parameters.
features: Real-time search dropdown with product suggestions as you type
Search results page with left sidebar filters (category, price range, brand, rating, stock)
Sort options: Relevance, Price Low-High, Price High-Low, Rating, Newest
Category pages with same filter sidebar
All filters shareable via URL parameters
Orange (#FF9900) accents on white background matching Amazon style
